messages:
maria: Heads-up: fncall structured validation rejections spiked in EU region last hour (x3). Seeing many 'missing_required_field' but payloads look fine. Thinking we need an offline reconciler to tag errors and feed dashboard with human-readable labels. Anyone else see this?
kevin: Yep saw it. Alerting went off. Rejections mostly from 'payments-connector' route. Sampling logs show intermittent 'content-type: application/json' double-encoded bodies.
olivia: is it actually schema parser or adapter? Could be adapter doing JSON.stringify twice. Repro steps?
jason: I ran a sample set — some toolhooks sending quoted JSON inside the 'response' string. Parser treats as string -> missing fields. We can auto-unquote for common patterns but that's risky.
maria: @olivia @jason ok proposal: build an offline reconciler job that ingests reject traces, runs heuristics (unquote, try-parse JSON arrays/objects), and emits labels: 'double-encoded', 'truncated', 'wrong-root', 'unknown-type'. Feed labels to dashboard and to rollout UI for canary decisioning.
elena: :+1: We need to track costs: reconciler will reparse potentially millions of rows. Suggest run on sampled rejects only, maybe 5%.
tom: Can we make reconciler idempotent and store original payload hash. Also add confidence score so console only surfaces >0.8 matches.
kevin: Telemetry: add new metric fncall_reconciler_label{label=...} and a histogram for confidence. Dashboards: show label burn-down per model/route.
maria: UX: in rollouts page show 'Recent schema errors' with label filters and ability to 'ignore label' for rollout gating. Also provide link to raw sample and reconciler inference trace.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: reconciler-worker v0.1 -> staging at 1759003000
olivia: Edge cases: tool calls that legitimately return stringified JSON as payloads (docs). So reconciler should not auto-fix — only tag and suggest 'safe-fix' rules that require human review.
jason: Will prototype a notebook with heuristics this afternoon. I'll post results here. quick grep example: `jq -r '.response' <sample.json` shows quoted object.
maria: Great. Action items: jason prototyping, kevin add telemetry counters, elena shard sampling policy, tom console flags for gating, olivia doc exceptions. I'll make a brief RFC tomorrow.
